请先加入企业，再绑定企业账号。: Join an organization before linking an organization account.
修改个人设置前，请验证当前账号密码。: Verify your current password before changing these settings.
请确认这两个账号都属于你。: Confirm that both accounts belong to you.
没有待确认的授权，请重新发起绑定。: There is no pending authorization. Start linking your account again.
通过此账号接收工作提醒。: Receive work reminders through this account.
下次可以通过企业账号进入工作空间。: Use your organization account to sign in next time.
使用已绑定的企业账号继续登录。: Continue with your linked organization account.
此企业登录入口暂不可用。: This organization sign-in is currently unavailable.
选择希望通过企业账号接收的工作提醒。: Choose which work reminders to receive through your organization account.
绑定企业账号后，可在这里选择自动通知。: Link an organization account to choose automatic notifications here.
此账号暂不能接收新通知，请检查绑定和接收设置。: This account cannot receive new notifications. Check its link and notification settings.
绑定当前企业的账号，用于接收通知或登录。: Link an account from this organization to receive notifications or sign in.
企业尚未开放账号绑定，请联系管理员。: Account linking is not available for this organization. Contact an administrator.
使用已绑定的企业账号进入工作空间。: Sign in to the workspace with your linked organization account.
企业暂未开放此渠道的通知发送。: Notifications through this channel are not enabled for your organization.
解除后，此账号将不能用于登录或接收新的通知。: After unlinking, this account cannot be used to sign in or receive new notifications.
复制失败，请选中地址后手动复制。: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it manually.
尚未设置应用密钥。: The application secret is not configured.
此接入平台暂不可用。: This integration platform is currently unavailable.
更换后需重新校验，再启用接入。: Verify the application again before enabling the integration.
成员可关联当前企业的渠道账号。: Members can link their channel account from this organization.
允许已绑定成员登录: Allow linked members to sign in
成员可通过此企业账号登录。: Members can sign in with this organization account.
向已绑定且允许接收的成员发送工作通知。: Send work notifications to linked members who have opted in.
配置企业微信和飞书，供成员绑定账号、登录和接收通知。: Connect WeCom and Feishu so members can link accounts, sign in and receive notifications.
删除后，成员不能再通过此接入登录或接收新通知。: Members will no longer be able to sign in or receive new notifications through this integration.
向已绑定并允许接收的成员发送一条测试通知。: Send a test notification to a linked member who has opted in.
没有符合条件的成员，请先完成账号绑定并允许接收通知。: No eligible members. Link an account and enable notifications first.
在飞书开发者后台创建企业自建应用，添加机器人能力，用于向成员发送个人通知。: Create a custom app in the Feishu Developer Console and add the bot capability to send personal notifications to members.
在企业微信管理后台的应用管理中创建自建应用，将需要绑定的成员加入应用可见范围。: Create a custom app under App Management in the WeCom Admin Console, and add the members who will link their accounts to its visibility range.
填写便于成员识别的名称，可与平台中的应用名称不同。: Choose a name that members can recognize. It can differ from the application's name on the provider's platform.
从企业微信管理后台“我的企业 → 企业信息”复制企业 ID。: Copy the organization ID from My Organization → Organization Information in the WeCom Admin Console.
从飞书应用的“凭证与基础信息”复制 App ID（应用编号）。: Copy the App ID from Credentials & Basic Information in your Feishu app.
从企业微信自建应用详情复制 AgentId（应用编号），填写数字。: Copy the numeric AgentId from your WeCom custom app's details.
从同一飞书应用的“凭证与基础信息”复制 App Secret（应用密钥）。: Copy the App Secret from Credentials & Basic Information in the same Feishu app.
从同一企业微信自建应用详情复制 Secret（应用密钥），与上面的应用编号对应。: Copy the Secret from the same WeCom custom app. It must correspond to the application ID above.
按企业微信允许的每日消息量设置。此值限制本平台的发送量，不会提高企业微信的额度。: Set this within WeCom's daily message allowance. This limits how many messages AgenTeam sends; it does not increase WeCom's allowance.
以应用的身份发消息，用于个人通知。: Send messages as the app, for personal notifications.
获取企业信息，用于校验应用所属企业。: Read organization information to verify which organization owns the app.
将需要绑定的成员加入应用可用范围，并发布版本，使能力与权限生效。: Add the members who will link their accounts to the app's availability range, then publish a version to activate its capabilities and permissions.
填入飞书应用“安全设置 → 重定向 URL”，完整复制协议、域名和路径。账号绑定: Add this under Security Settings → Redirect URLs in your Feishu app. Copy the full protocol, domain and path. Account linking and sign-in use the same callback.
按自建应用的网页授权与 Web 登录设置配置可信域名和授权回调域。域名取自下方回: Configure the trusted domain and authorization callback domain in your custom app's web authorization and web sign-in settings. Use the domain from the callback below; if a full callback URL is required, copy the entire address.
先保存接入，再打开“查看配置”复制生成的授权回调地址。: Save the integration first, then open View settings to copy its generated authorization callback URL.
如需从飞书工作台打开登录入口，添加网页应用能力，将 PC 端和移动端主页填写为本: To open sign-in from the Feishu workplace, add the web app capability and use this integration's organization sign-in URL for both desktop and mobile homepages.
如需从企业微信工作台打开登录入口，将应用主页填写为本接入的企业登录链接。: To open sign-in from the WeCom workplace, use this integration's organization sign-in URL as the app homepage.
企业登录链接在保存接入后生成，可从“查看配置”复制。: The organization sign-in URL is generated when you save the integration. Copy it from View settings.
此链接供成员打开登录页面，不能填作授权回调地址。成员需先绑定账号并允许通过此接入: This link opens the sign-in page; do not use it as a callback URL. Members must first link their accounts and allow sign-in through this integration.
发送个人通知无需填写消息发送地址。开启应用的发送能力后，本平台会按已绑定的账号发: You do not need to enter a URL to send personal notifications. Once messaging is enabled, AgenTeam sends notifications to linked accounts.
本接入不需要配置“事件与回调”的请求地址或消息卡片回调地址，保持未配置即可。授权: This integration does not require a request URL under Events & Callbacks or a message card callback URL. Leave them unset. The authorization callback is only for account authorization.
本接入不需要配置“接收消息”的服务器地址、Token（验证令牌）或 Encodi: This integration does not require the server URL, verification Token or EncodingAESKey under Receive Messages. The authorization callback is only for account authorization.
在企业微信应用的可信 IP 中配置部署服务器的实际公网出口地址，网页域名不能代替: Add the deployment server's actual public outbound IP address to the WeCom app's trusted IPs. A website domain cannot replace this address.
开启后，成员可在个人设置中授权并绑定此渠道，已有其他渠道的绑定会保留。: Members can authorize and link this channel in their personal settings. Existing links to other channels are preserved.
开启后，普通成员还需在个人绑定中允许登录。超级管理员继续使用本地账号登录。: Members must also allow sign-in in their linked account settings. Super administrators continue to sign in with a local account.
开启后可向已绑定且允许接收的成员发通知。自动工作提醒还需成员按类别主动开启。: Notifications can be sent to linked members who have opted in. Members must also enable each category of automatic work reminders they want to receive.
保存接入，复制生成的地址并完成平台后台设置。: Save the integration, copy the generated URLs and finish setup in the provider's console.
发布飞书应用版本，按企业要求完成审核，确认使用成员在应用可用范围内。: Publish a Feishu app version, complete any required organizational review, and ensure the intended members can access the app.
确认使用成员在企业微信应用可见范围内，完成可信域名和可信 IP 设置。: Ensure the intended members can see the WeCom app, and configure its trusted domains and IPs.
回到接入列表，在更多操作中点击“校验应用”，通过后点击“启用”。: Return to the integrations list, choose Check application from the more actions menu, then select Enable after the check passes.
成员在“个人设置 → 企业账号绑定”完成授权，按需要打开接收通知、登录和自动通知: Members authorize under Settings → Linked accounts, then enable notifications, sign-in and automatic notification categories as needed.
在接入卡片点击“测试通知”，选择已绑定成员，确认该成员实际收到消息。: Choose Test notification on the integration card, select a linked member, and confirm that they receive the message.
更换应用密钥后，需要重新校验并启用接入。: After replacing the app secret, check the application again and enable the integration.
